releaseNotes:
• Pixel-Grade UI Redesign: Native edge-to-edge insets, dynamic top bar, and fluid navigation transitions
• Redesigned Bottom Navigation Bar & Drawer: Streamlined navigation with continuous sliding animations
• Direct Room Credentials & Slot Board: Live room credentials with 1-tap copy and real-time slot tracking
• Enhanced Forced Update Gate: Streamlined in-app update experience with real-time download progress
• Performance & Theme Optimization: Hardware-accelerated motion curves and refined dark/light color palette
